questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: You cannot turn right where this sign is posted. Turning right at this intersection is unsafe and illegal.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop at this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you a divided highway is starting ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A five-sided yellow or yellow-green sign warns you of a school zone or school crossing ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always stop, whether there is a stop sign or not.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always sound your horn when you see children.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Five-sided signs mean you are approaching a school zone or school crossing. Be alert and prepare to stop when you see this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign alerts you to a side road intersecting ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Until after you pass the sign.
Unless it seems safe to do so.

questions.explanation: A white rectangular sign shows a rule you must follow. This sign means you cannot pass other vehicles under any circumstances.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits U-turns. You cannot turn around to go in the opposite direction at an intersection with this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign tells you a divided highway is beginning and you should drive on the right side.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Turning on a red signal is prohibited.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turning on a red signal is prohibited.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that turning right or left when the traffic light is red is not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that U-turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs warn drivers of upcoming hazards or special conditions. They are usually yellow or orange.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits turns in the direction shown by the arrow. In this case, right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that your road will end at an intersection ahead. Slow down and be ready to yield or stop before turning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that you are leaving a one-way highway and entering a two-way highway where traffic flows in both directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road curves to the right, then curves to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign is posted where you are not allowed to enter, such as on one-way streets or expressway ramps in the wrong direction. Do not pass this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: An upcoming construction or maintenance area.

questions.correctAnswerText: An upcoming construction or maintenance area.
questions.explanation: This orange diamond-shaped warning sign alerts you to construction or maintenance work ahead. Be prepared to slow down or change lanes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians walking along the road ahead.

questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that pedestrians may cross the road ahead. If a pedestrian is in a crosswalk, you must stop and stay stopped until they have crossed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for people with disabilities. Only vehicles with disability license plates, Disabled Veteran plates, or disability placards can park there.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars on the right move first.
Let cross traffic pass before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let cross traffic pass before proceeding.
questions.explanation: This sign means you must yield the right-of-way. Slow down and let other vehicles and pedestrians cross ahead of you. Stop if you need to.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and yield to trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield to trains.
questions.explanation: A round sign means a railroad crossing is ahead. This sign appears a few hundred feet before the tracks. It tells you to slow down, look, listen, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead winds with a series of turns or curves.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that wet roads are slippery. Drive carefully and reduce your speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Pentagonal signs warn that you are in or near a school zone or school crossing. Watch for children and follow the posted speed limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the divided highway ends ahead. Be ready to change lanes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The right lane is ending and traffic should merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane is ending and traffic should merge left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert you to immediate hazards. This sign warns that the number of lanes ahead will decrease. Move to the left lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are approaching the end of a divided highway.
You are approaching the beginning of a divided highway.
The road will be slippery ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are approaching the beginning of a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign means a divided highway is starting ahead. Stay to the right of the median divider.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a sharp turn to the right.
A right turn is permitted on a green arrow only.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a sharp turn to the right.
questions.explanation: Some warning signs have a fluorescent yellow-green background. These signs warn of upcoming hazards like curves and sharp turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An orange triangle on the back of a vehicle means it travels slowly. You will see this on farm equipment, roadwork vehicles, and horse-drawn wagons. It appears as a solid orange triangle during the day and a hollow red triangle at night.
